items.html: You know that the root of ZA is only six Sefirot. However, afterwards, they grew and became ten Sefirot for it. Similarly, the root of Malchut is one dot, which is later made to incorporate ten Sefirot. Thus, in their first root, they are only seven kings, six in ZA and one in Nukva. These cling to the last two letters of the Name, which are Vav-Hey, and these two letters are eleven in Gematria. This is the meaning of the eleven signs of the incense: ten inner Sefirot, and one surrounding. Although the surrounding also consists of ten Sefirot, it is called one.
